scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic via exact Gaussian moments, finite-zero Hadamard factorization, an exponential-series Rouché argument, and a radial complex-Hessian inequality. Numerical tests are finite reproducibility checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Infinitely many zeros for each mixture; first simple negative real zero and sharp smallest-modulus logarithmic law only as epsilon tends to zero. No full angular zero distribution, all-parameter negative-real-zero classification, or numerical-independent audit. Historical publication-priority assessment is not exhaustive; the full Hu–Lv–Schuster paper was not accessible.
title: Gaussian-mixture Fock kernels: global zeros under smooth positive-curvature perturbations
